facts.text: Season 1 closely adapted Blake Crouch's 2016 novel, and Crouch himself created the series, showran it and wrote most of the teleplays, which is a big reason it stayed so faithful.
Season 2 is not an adaptation: it is an original sequel story written by Crouch, ten new episodes that go beyond the book.
The show adds a deceased twin for Jason and Daniela's son Charlie, a change from the novel where he is their only child.
Crouch credits star Joel Edgerton with coming up with the series' biggest departure from the book.
